messages:
nora: FYI Globex onboarding failing on audit export. Their SIEM drops ~40% of events. :frowning:


diego: what errors are they surfacing?

nora: gist from their support:
- parser choke on sub-ms timestamps (they want epoch_ms or ISO w/o microseconds)
- events with action:role.change show actor:null (they need an actor.id)
- header mismatch: they only accept X-RDWD-KMS-ARN for KMS envelope verification; we send X-RDWD-KMS-ENC after recent rotation

sam: quick repro looked like this (sanitized):

```
POST /ingest/audit HTTP/1.1
Host: ingest.globex.example
X-RDWD-KMS-ENC: key-alias/rdwd-03
X-RDWD-SIGN: MEUCIQ... (base64)
Content-Type: application/json

{"timestamp":"2026-03-20T08:12:01.987654Z","event":"rbac.change","details":{...}}
```

mira: hmm. two separate classes: schema compatibility (timestamps + actor) and delivery integration (KMS header).

diego: for actor.id we started omitting for automated infra jobs after the RBAC refactor. We can populate actor.id with `system/<service>` for those flows as a compatibility backfill.

sam: delivery-side patch plan:
1) add epoch_ms derived from timestamp and a trimmed `ts_ms` field (ms precision)
2) always include actor.id where we can; fallback to system alias when missing
3) accept both `X-RDWD-KMS-ARN` and `X-RDWD-KMS-ENC` headers. If ARN present, set signature_mode=kms-verify. If ENC only, set signature_mode=hsm-envelope and include x-rdwd-kms-alias in meta

nora: also note Globex's Splunk HEC rejects gzipped payloads with Content-Encoding: gzip. They expected raw JSON. Our batch exporter gzips for S3. Need to clarify which sinks get gzipped in docs.

mira: add a compatibility warning in tenant settings UI if they use non-default signature headers or custom compression settings so support can see it quickly.

security-ops: created incident SEC-2026-03-20-GLOBEX-1 (Priority P2) to track. Assigning sam for delivery patch.

sam: rolling PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/delivery/pulls/3901 (WIP). Included unit tests that post to a local verifier that accepts both header styles.

diego: we should tag this as audit-schema v2.2 (minor) and include changelog line: "timestamp aliases (epoch_ms, ts_ms), actor.id backfill for infra events, dual KMS envelope header support, guidance on gzip for HEC/S3 sinks".

nora: test vectors please. Globex wants a curl example that shows KMS ARN flow and HSM flow.

sam: added two curl examples to the PR comment. example (kms-arn flow):

```
curl -X POST https://ingest.globex.example/ingest/audit \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-RDWD-KMS-ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111222:key/abcd-1234" \
  --data '{"timestamp":"2026-03-20T08:12:01.987Z","epoch_ms":1710894721987,"actor":{"id":"user/jane"},"event":"rbac.change"}'
```

mira: ops-bot, can you add a support playbook checklist item to ask partners for: preferred timestamp format, KMS verification method (ARN vs raw), HEC gzip tolerance?

ops-bot: added checklist item 4.7 to onboarding playbook.

diego: also adding metric alert: tenant webhook rejects >3% in 30m -> paging oncall and escalates to security-ops.

security-ops: noted. will coordinate vuln triage if signature fallback exposes raw-signature acceptance that could be abused.

nora: good point. diego, ensure fallback is opt-in per-tenant, and require explicit acceptance in contract when we send raw hsm envelopes instead of KMS ARNs.

sam: implemented opt-in flag and a console notice. PR updated. ETA for canary today evening.

nora: once canary passes, coordinate with Globex to re-run ingest and confirm their parser accepts the ts_ms and actor.id. Close SEC incident after confirmation and add a short postmortem in incidents/ with remediation steps.

mira: adding to release notes and internal changelog. ping me when PR merges.

sam: will post final test report and curl vectors once canary completes. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
